mechanisms.label: Diesel / refining crisis
mechanisms.summary: The candidate set contains several LEAD‑phase reports that collectively indicate a tightening of middle‑distillate supplies driven by refinery outages and constrained product flows, rather than a crude shortage. The evidence points to elevated diesel/jet crack spreads, falling or stagnant Brent prices, and record refinery margins that have not translated into higher refinery runs. No contradictory evidence is present in the supplied candidates.
